name: Crownsfall
look: Warm limestone plaza, blue-gold banners, market terraces
quest_text: meet archivist Mira Thorne; investigate missing royal courier Joren Pike and a bell heard by only a few citizens.
encounter: Tutorial combat, civic hub, first memory of a vanished courier.
reveal: Mira becomes the field contact.

name: Kingsroad Fields
quest_text: escort a grain cart and investigate a road marker whose distance changes.
encounter: Bandits and displaced wildlife; road reappears when a witness names it.
reveal: Recover the courier's route.

name: Bramblewatch
quest_text: rescue scout Rowan from scavengers at a collapsed bridge.
reveal: Courier carried a black glass seal.

name: Greenwood Marches
look: Fern forest, streams, ancient root bridges
quest_text: follow impossible winter tracks into summer woods.
encounter: Track phase beasts; teach environmental clues.
reveal: An animal remembers an extinct river.

name: Mossbell Hamlet
quest_text: investigate three households with conflicting memories of a missing child.
encounter: Interview witnesses and clear a haunted mill.
reveal: Multiple accounts can coexist.

name: Silverroot Grove
look: Two overlapping forests, amber leaves suspended
quest_text: Lorecast an old hunter's bow to open a brief echo.
encounter: First stable temporal pocket; fight an echo stag without harming witnesses.
reveal: Unlock basic Lorecasting.

name: Ashen Tollway
quest_text: recover the courier's satchel from a road cult.
reveal: Seal belongs to the Keepers of Names.

name: Bellwater Mills
quest_text: rescue workers and stop a reversed flood.
encounter: Valve and combat puzzle, mill guardian.
reveal: Rifts obey local anchor pressure.

name: Highward Steps
quest_text: confront Marshal Garran over quarantined relics.
encounter: Gate defense; choose witness dialogue without blocking story.
reveal: Gain authorized access to the lower city.

name: Sablemarket Vaults
look: Merchant crypts, bronze shutters, secret ledgers
quest_text: free a captured Keeper named Tamsin.
reveal: Aurelian records predate the kingdom.

name: Old Crown Cistern
look: Flooded masonry with flickering original streets
quest_text: drain a chamber and follow an echo of a procession.
reveal: Crownsfall contains older city layers.

name: Undercroft
look: Buried crypt avenues, candle niches, violet seepage
quest_text: descend past the Regent's guards.
encounter: Crypt enemy families; unlock shrine waypoint.
reveal: A royal guard protects a door.

name: Cathedral of the Nameless
look: Violet ruined nave, shattered stained glass
quest_text: defeat Ser Caldrin Vael, then Lorecast his shield.
encounter: Boss with defensive stances; mandatory quiet memory of wife Elara Vael and daughter Lys.
reveal: The apparent monster was an erased father.

name: First Anchor Chamber
look: Huge bronze rings under the cathedral, floating inscriptions
quest_text: align Caldrin's name with the courier's seal; resist the Hollow Choir.
encounter: Anchor sentinel boss; stabilize and rescue Joren Pike, whose recent displacement is reversible.
reveal: The missing courier returns; Engine is alive and the present has a deadline.

name: Crownsfall Citadel
look: Royal court, gathering refugees, dusk over city
quest_text: present proof to Regent Maera; defend the court from a small reality tear.
encounter: Public reveal and siege finale; permanent hub refugee changes.
reveal: Receive warrant to investigate the outer scars.

name: Westgate Refuge
quest_text: organize safe passage and investigate missing refugee records.
reveal: Introduce Veyr envoy Iri.

name: Thornfen
look: Mist bog, drowned chapels, reed boats
quest_text: retrieve a bell from beneath the fen.
reveal: One village has two dates of destruction.

name: Glassreed Marsh
quest_text: trace a drowned surveyor's map.
encounter: Switch between paths at stable nodes.
reveal: Locate western anchor lines.

name: Blackpine Reach
quest_text: negotiate supplies and clear a corrupted logging camp.
reveal: Remnant Court agents buy artifacts.

name: Hearthstone Crossing
quest_text: reconcile conflicting toll records.
encounter: Bridge defense; optional rival faction reputation.
reveal: Two monarchs ruled the same dates.

name: Veyr Meridian Outpost
quest_text: meet Meridian and undergo a phase-safety trial.
encounter: Hub; tutorial anchor timing and Veyr factions.
reveal: Veyr know the Engine's cycles.

name: Windcut Pass
quest_text: deliver a warning before a scar expands.
reveal: A scar expands on a known pulse.

name: Riftglass Quarry
quest_text: free miners from a Riftbinder experiment.
reveal: Anchor crystals are memory conductors.

name: Forgotten Bastion
quest_text: witness a lost siege and recover a military index.
encounter: Switch routes between epochs; siege specter.
reveal: Caldrin served a civilization older than the current kingdom.

name: Greywake Coast
quest_text: retrieve sea logs and rescue lighthouse keepers.
reveal: Scars form a continental circuit.

name: Saltmirror Harbor
look: Golden Age docks over modern fishing port
quest_text: examine a manifest of impossible imports.
encounter: Cargo crane puzzle and temporal smugglers.
reveal: Golden Age trade used anchor transport.

name: Timekeeper's Causeway
quest_text: repair markers as Timekeepers defend the route.
reveal: Seven principal anchor circuits identified.

name: Scar of Hollow Rain
look: Rain suspended around a broken town
quest_text: enter a tear and speak to a coherent Unwritten envoy.
reveal: The Unwritten are people with factions.

name: West Meridian Vault
quest_text: prevent Choir cantor Neral from destroying an anchor.
encounter: Boss redirects scar beams; save evacuation path.
reveal: Anchor network can be tuned, not simply smashed.

name: Meridian Observatory
quest_text: assemble recovered records with Meridian.
encounter: Act finale: defend the calibration chamber; unlock specialization and expedition.
reveal: Discover the Golden Age coordinates.

name: Sunward Threshold
look: Golden light, intact monumental transit gate
quest_text: stabilize the first extended historical pocket.
encounter: Teach coherent echo civilians; anchor defense.
reveal: Historical spaces are not free time travel.

name: Aurelian Forum
quest_text: escort scholar Elyndor through a public debate.
reveal: Meet Golden Age political factions.

name: Lumen Canal
quest_text: restore a canal and interview maintenance guilds.
reveal: Engine technology once prevented famine.

name: Orchard of Hours
quest_text: stop a malfunctioning irrigation clock.
reveal: Preservation changes living ecosystems.

name: Artificers' Ward
look: Brass workshops, ceramic roofs, clockwork cranes
quest_text: help engineer Sera Voss locate missing test records.
reveal: A hidden trial erased a work crew from public memory.

name: Sapphire Academy
quest_text: attend a reconstruction of the Engine's founding lecture.
reveal: Engine was intended to preserve civilization, not reset it.

name: Workers' Terrace
quest_text: rescue laborers after an illegal phase test.
encounter: Street rescue and union witness dialogue.
reveal: Costs fell on politically powerless districts.

name: Garden of Civic Memory
quest_text: identify unregistered names.
reveal: Unrecorded lives vanish first during errors.

name: Astral Foundry
quest_text: recover a component from a production accident.
reveal: Engine can separate matter from recorded history.

name: Concord Senate
quest_text: recover two versions of a Senate vote.
encounter: Investigative encounter; witness a rigged emergency law.
reveal: Chancellor Valen Oris gains control of the project.

name: Vael Estate
look: Modest garden house, children's toys, sunroom
quest_text: find Caldrin's family alive within a memory.
encounter: Noncombat family scene followed by protective duel.
reveal: Humanize Caldrin and establish Lys as a later witness.

name: Elyndor's Archive
quest_text: protect Elyndor as he hides evidence.
reveal: He predicted erased histories would persist.

name: Chronicle Perimeter
quest_text: enter an authorized inspection route.
reveal: Engine has seven regulating anchors.

name: Preservation Laboratory
quest_text: reconstruct a failed attempt to save the terminally ill.
encounter: Contain unstable echoes; rescue simulated subjects.
reveal: No restoration can simply undo all deaths.

name: Concord Crown Spire
look: Capital skyline and ceremonial engine overlook
quest_text: witness Oris announce universal preservation while suppressing dissent.
encounter: Act boss: corrupted ceremonial protector; exit collapsing pocket.
reveal: Follow the last days of the Golden Age.

name: Last Dawn Station
quest_text: locate a route into the final day.
reveal: Establish the historical countdown sequence.

name: Cinder Orchard
quest_text: save witnesses during a weather failure.
reveal: Anchor stress predates the public emergency.

name: South Reservoir
quest_text: divert water and recover Sera's diagnostic.
reveal: Engineering failures cascade across anchors.

name: Labor Quarter Siege
quest_text: protect evacuees from hardline soldiers.
reveal: Oris ordered sealed districts.

name: Hall of Seven Measures
quest_text: reconstruct safety interlocks.
reveal: Oris disabled an ethical failsafe.

name: Vael's Last Road
quest_text: accompany Caldrin toward the evacuation cathedral.
reveal: Caldrin refused an order to abandon civilians.

name: Cathedral Before the Fall
quest_text: record refugees and Caldrin's family.
reveal: Establish a recoverable identity ledger.

name: Senate of Ash
quest_text: witness the final dispute between Elyndor, Sera and Oris.
reveal: Oris knowingly chose a reset.

name: Chronicle Access Ring
quest_name: The Door That Should Stay Shut
quest_text: follow Sera's failed abort sequence.
reveal: Manual abort was attempted too late.

name: The First Sundering
look: Capital split by violet seams, falling architecture
quest_text: survive the first activation and protect witness records.
encounter: Escaping battlefield; no victory that changes history.
reveal: The reset deletes the epoch, not its people.

name: The Empty Morning
quest_text: follow the erased population through the void.
reveal: The Unwritten were born from erasure.

name: Remnant Court Refuge
quest_text: negotiate with Queen Ysara.
reveal: Remnant Court wants restoration at any cost.

name: Hollow Choir Reliquary
quest_text: rescue a witness from Choir conversion.
reveal: Some Unwritten surrender identities for unity.

name: Keepers' Lantern
look: Archive camp of warm lanterns and paper tags
quest_text: help Tamsin and Lys preserve the record.
reveal: Individual identities can endure without replacement.

name: Engine of First Night
look: The initial control core frozen in disaster
quest_text: confront the emergency protocol avatar.
encounter: Boss with repeated arena states; recover original failsafe; unlock heroic identity at level 40.
reveal: The reset timer remains active in the present.

name: Broken Meridian
quest_text: rescue Meridian and recover Rowan, whose identity is beginning to flicker out of the present.
encounter: Defense and diagnosis; recover forecast and stabilize Rowan temporarily.
reveal: Next reset begins after three more anchor failures.

name: Throne of Glass
look: Royal halls from a vanished epoch
quest_text: hear Ysara's terms and investigate her missing people.
reveal: Her restoration plan would overwrite present inhabitants.

name: Rain Kingdom
look: Perpetual rain, canals, dark slate towers
quest_name: The City of a Thousand Floods
quest_text: recover an epoch's flood records.
reveal: A later epoch was erased after refusing Engine control.

name: Verdant Empire
quest_text: save a living archive from collapse.
reveal: Some civilizations adapted to the Engine rather than fearing it.

name: Iron Sabbath
quest_text: recover a workers' testimony before the pocket closes.
reveal: The Engine reset dissenting societies, not just disasters.

name: Moonfall Republic
quest_text: discover a vote to dismantle the Engine.
reveal: An earlier attempt nearly succeeded.

name: The Orchard of Lost Children
look: Floating houses, small lanterns, gentle grass
quest_text: help Lys locate a family ledger.
reveal: Memories can anchor families without coercion.

name: Court of Borrowed Faces
quest_text: expose Court agents replacing living people.
reveal: Replacement is not resurrection.

name: The Choir's Deep
quest_text: retrieve a captive echo from Neral.
reveal: The Choir seeks to merge all selves into one.

name: Unbound Causeway
look: Floating bridge fragments from many cultures
quest_text: stabilize crossings for refugees.
reveal: Coexistence requires independent anchors.

name: Crownsfall of Three Ages
look: Same plaza in three architectural versions
quest_name: The City That Was Never Built
quest_text: overlay inscriptions with Mira.
reveal: Crownsfall is assembled from discarded epochs.

name: The Regent's Archive
quest_text: confront Maera with the truth.
encounter: Court dialogue and attempted coup defense.
reveal: The current kingdom knowingly buried evidence, not the whole truth.

name: Hearth of Names
look: Keeper sanctuary, warm lights among ruins
quest_text: recruit witnesses from every erased epoch.
reveal: The reconciliation path becomes actionable.

name: Riven Royal Court
quest_text: confront Ysara's restoration assault.
encounter: Boss can end with negotiated ceasefire if evidence gathered; otherwise retreat.
reveal: Court remains politically active but stops forced replacement locally.

name: The Anchor of Kinship
quest_text: stabilize a small coexistence experiment with Rowan and a consenting displaced family.
reveal: Rowan retains his identity; independent parallel lives can be supported without erasure.

name: Crownsfall Under Siege
quest_text: defend the market and evacuate civilians.
reveal: Present-day people are the stakes, not scenery.

name: Greenwood Fracture
look: Forest split across seasons and ages
quest_text: restore the western regulator.
reveal: Regulator of Growth secured.

name: Bellwater Inundation
quest_text: rescue millworkers and tune water conduit.
reveal: Regulator of Flow secured.

name: Greywake Armada
look: Wrecked harbor, ships from other epochs
quest_text: unite sailors and Court refugees.
reveal: Regulator of Passage secured.

name: Blackpine Winter
look: Summer camp surrounded by lethal frost
quest_text: recover displaced villagers and repair a thermal node.
reveal: Regulator of Balance secured.

name: Riftglass Caldera
quest_text: stop an overload before it spreads.
reveal: Regulator of Form secured.

name: Veyr Sanctuary
quest_text: reconcile Veyr factions over emergency action.
reveal: Veyr agree to release suppressed records.

name: Archive of Forbidden Futures
quest_text: recover testimony about failed resets.
reveal: The Engine also erased possible futures during branching.

name: The Sentinel's Wall
quest_text: defend Epoch Sentinels during evacuation.
encounter: Wave defense with safe recovery checkpoints.
reveal: Regulator of Boundary secured.

name: Meridian's Descent
quest_text: learn Meridian helped conceal an earlier warning.
reveal: Meridian accepts responsibility, not immunity.

name: The Last Timekeeper
quest_text: retrieve the final regulator index.
reveal: Regulator of Continuity secured.

name: The Choir's Procession
look: Violet march across fields and ruined towns
quest_text: break the Choir's forced conversions.
reveal: Neral's true identity can be recovered.

name: Confluence Camp
look: Allied encampment, banners of many epochs
quest_text: choose coalition priorities and audit witness evidence.
encounter: Noncombat strategic choices; optional quests remain accessible.
reveal: Final paths explained before commitment.

name: Sevenfold Gate
quest_text: deploy regulators to open the route to the Engine.
encounter: Seven short encounters with distinct mechanics.
reveal: No solution works without all seven functions.

name: The Threshold of Continuance
look: A bronze horizon beneath a white sun
quest_text: face the Continuance's outer avatar.
encounter: Act boss; countdown changes world state, not real-time access.
reveal: The Engine offers a reset and exposes Oris's surviving directive.

name: The First Index
quest_text: enter the Engine and verify the witness ledger.
reveal: Every person has an independent record.

name: Vault of Continuity
look: Interlocking bronze rings and white light
quest_name: The Choice of the First Makers
quest_text: reconstruct the original safety architecture.
reveal: Original design permitted distributed anchoring.

name: The Mercy Chamber
look: Quiet clinical halls repeating a last conversation
quest_text: witness Sera's final sacrifice.
reveal: Restoration cannot return ordinary deaths or undo every loss.

name: The King's Unmaking
look: Oris's chambers and a crumbling capital
quest_text: confront the origin of Oris's directive.
reveal: The Continuance inherited a fear of extinction, not a human soul.

name: The Remnant Siege
look: Royal forces at the central gate
quest_text: settle Ysara's final claim.
encounter: Ceasefire route if negotiated; otherwise boss and surrender.
reveal: Forced replacement rejected or exposed.

name: The Choir's Last Hymn
quest_text: defeat Neral's fusion ritual.
encounter: Boss with silence and identity mechanics.
reveal: Recovered name enables individual surrender; no compulsory redemption.

name: Caldrin's Vigil
look: The cathedral threshold from Act 1, restored
quest_text: reunite Caldrin's record with Lys and his family's testimony.
reveal: Caldrin voluntarily becomes a witness, not fuel.

name: The Seven Chambers
quest_text: align the recovered regulators.
reveal: Each act's knowledge becomes a mechanical solution.

name: The Crown of Empty Histories
quest_text: prevent the Engine ranking epochs by value.
reveal: All surviving records receive equal status.

name: The Unwritten Shore
look: Quiet sea of lights, refugee bridges
quest_text: protect the first independent refuge anchors.
encounter: Large escort and defense; reconciliation readiness check.
reveal: The Between can persist without being a prison.

name: Chronicle Heart
quest_text: confront the Continuance.
encounter: Three-phase final boss with reset, erase, overwrite mechanics.
reveal: Emergency directive loses authority.

name: The Last Decision
quest_text: choose reset, severance, or distributed reconciliation.
encounter: Explicit ending UI; no accidental choice.
reveal: Campaign ending committed once confirmed.

name: Crownsfall Reborn
quest_text: return to Mira, Maera, and surviving allies.
encounter: Epilogue quests; visible NPC and architecture changes.
reveal: Consequences shown in human terms.

name: The Open Meridian
quest_text: survey the new state of the world.
reveal: Future play does not invalidate the chosen ending.

name: The Lantern Beyond
quest_text: place Caldrin's ledger in a public memorial.
encounter: Final dialogue and optional credits walk.
reveal: The final image is a remembered name, not a reset.
